description: Polyphonic pitch rescaler: it finds the degree of the incoming note in a source scale and puts out the note at that degree of a target scale

inputs.text: The pitch to rescale, one channel per voice
The source scale the incoming pitch is read against, one channel per note of it; with nothing patched the scale is C major
The scale the pitch is rescaled into, one channel per note of it; with nothing patched the scale is C major
A note voltage picks which degree of the target scale becomes the root of the scale actually used

outputs.text: The rescaled pitch taken from the target scale as it stands, with the CHILD input left out of the reckoning
The rescaled pitch taken from the target scale rotated to the degree chosen by the CHILD input
The notes of the target scale rotated to the degree chosen by the CHILD input, one channel per note

notes: with both scale inputs empty each scale is C major and the pitch comes out as it went in; a scale input takes one note per channel, as the POW output of Mother gives in Scale Pitches mode
menu: Child CV Mode — reads the CHILD voltage as In Scale, the note itself, or as Relative [C4], measured from the root of the target scale
Relative Flats — a pitch that is not in the source scale is read as the note above it flattened, rather than as the note below it
